description: This line plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 scores for four different model configurations—T5 + LoRA, MBart + LoRA, T5 + AdaLoRA, and MBart + AdaLoRA—across varying values of the parameter log r, which ranges from 0 to 9 on a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “ROUGE-1,” spans from 0 to 35, with major gridlines at intervals of 5. The T5 + LoRA configuration (red circles, solid line) begins at approximately 23.5 at log r = 0 and remains relatively stable, peaking slightly at 24.5 around log r = 6 before gently declining to 24.0 at log r = 9. The MBart + LoRA configuration (blue circles, solid line) starts at 5.0, dips to 2.5 at log r = 2, then rises sharply to 19.0 at log r = 4, continuing to climb to 23.0 at log r = 8 before slightly decreasing to 23.5 at log r = 9. The T5 + AdaLoRA configuration (green circles, solid line) begins at 23.5, increases gradually to 27.0 at log r = 4, then plateaus near 30.0 from log r = 6 to 9. The MBart + AdaLoRA configuration (orange circles, solid line) starts at 5.0, rises steeply to 19.5 at log r = 3, then continues climbing to 32.0 at log r = 4, after which it stabilizes around 33.5 from log r = 6 to 9. All lines are connected with solid lines and marked with circular data points.
